_comment: Every email this app sends, uploaded to SendGrid by
scripts/upload-sendgrid-templates.mts. The HTML here is the SOURCE OF TRUTH —
edit it, re-run the script, and SendGrid gets a new active version. Edits made
in SendGrid's UI are silently overwritten by the next run.
`slug` links a template to a class in the manifest Sheet. Templates with no
slug (transactional mail) are referenced by env var instead.
Note 4a: the class the audience knows as Class 4 has manifest slug 4a, and
there is no class 4 — /class/4 renders "we couldn't find that class".
